Hi Priya / Carlos 	6

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and the asks we discussed: 

- Primary goal: reduce LLM inference cost while maintaining sub-200ms p99 latency for customer-facing personalization and search features.
- Decision criteria mentioned: latency / cost tradeoffs, security/compliance (SOC2 + data residency), and ease of integration (Node/Python SDKs).

Could you help map the internal stakeholders so we can tailor the next conversations? Specifically: 
- Economic buyer (owner of the budget / procurement lead)
- Security / compliance reviewer for vendor assessments
- Legal / contracting contact for SOW/NDA procurement
- Any engineering leads who should join the technical deep-dive (ML infra / backend)

Suggested next steps:
1) Tech deep-dive (45m) with engineering + Marissa to run through latency profiles and integration patterns. Possible windows: Oct 13 or Oct 15 (PST).
2) Procurement + security sync to align on questionnaire timeline and contract cadence (we can provide SOC2, network diagrams, and an initial security package).

If you can share an org chart or intro chain (or attach who owns procurement/security/legal), that would be extremely helpful so we can put together a tailored mutual action plan.

Thanks 	6 happy to be flexible on times.

Best,
Alex Martinez
